description:
A field survey team needs all project GIS data consolidated into a single GeoPackage (.gpkg) file for their mobile mapping application. You have three separate GeoJSON data layers that need to be packaged together.

The source data files are:
1. Polygon zones: /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_polygon.geojson (2 polygon features)
2. Monitoring stations: /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_points.geojson (3 point features)
3. Road network: /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_lines.geojson (2 line features)

Using QGIS, perform the following:
1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load all three GeoJSON layers into the current project.
3. Export each layer into a single GeoPackage file located at: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/project_data.gpkg
   - Export the polygon layer with the layer name 'zones'
   - Export the point layer with the layer name 'stations'
   - Export the line layer with the layer name 'roads'
   IMPORTANT: When adding the second and third layers, make sure to append them as new layers within the existing GeoPackage file (do not overwrite/replace the file).
4. Save the QGIS project to: /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/delivery_project.qgs (or .qgz)

The final GeoPackage must contain all three layers with the specified names.
